tagline: The right animal, or no sale at all.
one_liner: A family-run pet and aquatics shop that matches animals to owners and backs every sale with real husbandry advice.

positioning.who_its_for: First-time keepers and families who want a pet still thriving a year in, not an impulse bought in a plastic cup.
positioning.what_problem: Big-box pet aisles sell the tank, the fish and the food in one trip and leave new owners to find out the hard way that the water wasn't ready.
positioning.why_them: Everyone on our counter keeps animals of their own, and we would rather talk you out of a sale than send an animal to the wrong home.

products.name: Cycled Aquarium Starter
products.description: A complete first aquarium delivered already running: tank, filter, heater and lighting cycled on our own bench for four weeks before it reaches your living room.
features: Tank, filter, heater and lighting included
Cycled in-store for 4 weeks before delivery
Free water test any time in the first 3 months

products.name: Small Animal Hamper
products.description: A monthly box for rabbits, guinea pigs and rats: fresh-cut hay, safe chews and one rotating enrichment toy, packed for the animals on your file rather than a generic box.
features: Fresh-cut oaten hay in every box
Chews vetted by our own keepers
One rotating enrichment toy each month

products.name: Nail, Wing and Health Check Visit
products.description: A booked visit at our counter for birds, rabbits and other small animals: nails and wings trimmed as needed, weight recorded, and husbandry questions answered on the spot.
features: Nails, wings and teeth checked and trimmed as needed
Weight recorded and compared against the last visit
Husbandry advice specific to your setup
Referral letter if the animal needs a vet

do: Name the species, the age and the setup before recommending anything
Say plainly when an animal is the wrong fit for a home
Describe the shop as it is at ten in the morning: sun through the front glass, planted tanks glowing green, water clear enough to read a label through
dont: Call an animal stock or a unit
Promise a pet will suit every household
Make the shop look dark, moody or dimly lit
Dress the shop in rustic, earthy, craft-shop warmth
